GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

A little clarity
before you start.

Still wondering about something?

Let’s get it sorted
Can I try FirstLane for free?

Yes. Explore 10 guest questions, or create a free account in the app for a fixed set of 40 Ontario practice questions, explanations and saved progress. There is no free-trial countdown.

Is CA$14.99 a subscription?

No. Ontario G1 Complete is a CA$14.99 one-time in-app purchase. There is no automatic renewal and no scheduled expiry on your Ontario pack. Apple or Google displays the final local price and any applicable taxes before you pay.

What does Ontario G1 Complete include?

The Ontario practice pack, focused topic practice, full mock sessions, mistake review, bookmarks and offline study after the pack is downloaded. Future jurisdictions are separate packs, not part of this purchase.

Can I study without an internet connection?

Downloaded study content can be used offline. You will still need a connection for account actions, purchases, downloads, syncing progress and periodic access checks. See the app for access-check requirements.

Is FirstLane the official Ontario G1 test?

No. FirstLane is an independent study tool, not an official test, government service or driving school. It is not affiliated with Ontario’s Ministry of Transportation or DriveTest. Practice results are not a guarantee of passing.

How do I restore a purchase or delete my account?

Purchase-restoration guidance is in Support. You can initiate deletion in the app, or visit Delete account without reinstalling FirstLane. Deletion does not automatically request a store refund.
